name: Projected minutes (distribution)
description: Pregame distribution of minutes played: mixture of P(DNP/limited) and a continuous component. The single most valuable projected quantity.

name: Foul-trouble minutes risk
description: Frequency of foul-limited minutes: share of last N games with PF >= 5, and PF per 36 minutes.
formula: rate_PF5 = mean(PF_{t-k} >= 5); PF36 = 36 * sum(PF)/sum(MIN) over last N games (N=20).
historical_availability: Computable for any season where the required box columns exist (verified populated 1983-84 onward in sampled seasons; PLUS_MINUS only 1996-97+).

name: Minutes change on back-to-backs
description: Player-specific difference in minutes on the second night of a back-to-back vs normal rest.
formula: delta = mean(MIN | days_rest=0) - mean(MIN | days_rest>=1), shrunk: delta_shrunk = n_b2b/(n_b2b+k) * delta; k tuned.

name: Return-from-absence ramp
description: Games since the player returned after missing >= M consecutive team games, and minutes in those games relative to pre-injury baseline.
formula: missed = team games (from schedule) with no row for the player and date < t; returned_flag if missed_prev >= M (M=3 tuned); ramp_ratio = MIN_since_return / MIN_median_before_absence.
historical_availability: Computable for any season where the required box columns exist (verified populated 1983-84 onward in sampled seasons; PLUS_MINUS only 1996-97+).

validation_method: Event study: minutes in the first 5 games back vs baseline.
notes: Absence cause (injury vs coach decision vs trade) is not in game logs; BoxScoreSummaryV3.InactivePlayers (historical) helps but is not a reason code.

name: Share of minutes in the 4th quarter
description: Fraction of a player's minutes played in period 4; high values mean the player is used in close games and low values signal blowout benching.
formula: q4_share = MIN(period=4) / MIN(all periods) from two calls: period=4 (verified honored, 580 rows) and no period filter, both with date_to = t-1.

name: Reconstructed rotation from play-by-play
description: Per-player on-court intervals rebuilt from substitution events. GameRotation (the official rotation chart) failed in every test, so PlayByPlayV3 is the only candidate source.
formula: Parse actionType="Substitution" rows ("SUB: X FOR Y"); infer period-start lineups from first events; integrate time on court. Accuracy vs box MIN must be checked per game before use.
historical_availability: Verified: PlayByPlayV3 returns rows for sampled games in 1996-97, 2003-04, 2007-08, 2012-13, 2013-14, 2015-16, 2016-17, 2019-20, 2022-23, 2025-26. Event-level accuracy for early seasons not audited.

name: Rolling usage
description: Minutes-weighted rolling mean of per-game usage rate over last N games.
formula: USG_N = sum(USG_{t-k}*MIN_{t-k}) / sum(MIN_{t-k}) over last N games, N in {5,10,20} + season-to-date.
historical_availability: Verified for 2025-26 and 2026-27 (PlayerGameLogs/TeamGameLogs). Deeper history of these exact endpoints is UNTESTED; the underlying values are reproducible from box columns for any season where those exist.

name: Usage from box columns
description: Own usage computation so history can extend beyond the seasons where PlayerGameLogs[Advanced] was verified.
source_columns: PlayerGameLogs[Base].FGA; PlayerGameLogs[Base].FTA; PlayerGameLogs[Base].TOV; PlayerGameLogs[Base].MIN; TeamGameLogs[Base].FGA; TeamGameLogs[Base].FTA; TeamGameLogs[Base].TOV; TeamGameLogs[Base].MIN
formula: USG = ((FGA + 0.44*FTA + TOV) * TeamMIN_per_player_slot) / (MIN * (TmFGA + 0.44*TmFTA + TmTOV)); TeamMIN_per_player_slot = TeamGameLogs.MIN (48 in regulation; verified that the team MIN column is 48, NOT 240).

name: FGA per 100 on-court possessions

name: Rolling true shooting

name: Expected FG% from shot quality

source_columns: LeagueSeasonMatchups.PARTIAL_POSS; LeagueSeasonMatchups.PLAYER_PTS; LeagueSeasonMatchups.MATCHUP_FGM; LeagueSeasonMatchups.MATCHUP_FGA; BoxScoreMatchupsV3.partialPossessions; BoxScoreMatchupsV3.playerPoints
formula: Aggregate per (offence, defence) pair, shrink heavily; weight by expected matchup probability, which requires predicting the defender - not available pregame from nba_api.
historical_availability: Verified: LeagueSeasonMatchups 0 rows for 2015-16 and 2016-17, rows for 2017-18 and 2025-26. BoxScoreMatchupsV3 / BoxScoreDefensiveV2 error for sampled 2016-17 and earlier games, work for 2017-18, 2018-19, 2019-20, 2022-23, 2025-26.
pregame_availability: Pairs: lagged yes; predicted defender: no
leakage_notes: Safe when computed only from games with GAME_DATE strictly before the target game date; recompute per target date.
missing_data_handling: Pair samples are tiny; default to team-level.
validation_method: Test only if a defender-assignment predictor exists.

name: Opponent rim protection (roster-aware)
description: Opponent's rim defence given who is available: minute-weighted defended-at-rim FG% of the expected opposing bigs.
formula: sum_j E[MIN_j]*D_FGA_per_min_j*PCT_PLUSMINUS_j / sum_j E[MIN_j]*D_FGA_per_min_j over opposing players (category "Less Than 6Ft"); needs opposing availability.
historical_availability: Verified: LeagueDashPtDefend rows for 2013-14, 2014-15, 2015-16, 2025-26 (2012-13 UNTESTED).
pregame_availability: Yes - projection built pregame from lagged/pregame inputs
leakage_notes: Leak-free only if every input is itself as-of the target date. Fit and evaluate with walk-forward splits; never random k-fold across dates.
missing_data_handling: Fewer than N prior games -> shrink toward prior-season value, then position/archetype league mean (empirical-Bayes weight n/(n+k)); emit games_in_window as a companion feature.
validation_method: Ablation.

name: Expected missed shots in the game

name: Expected on-court possessions
description: Possessions the player will be on the floor for: projected minutes x projected game pace / 48, times the player's on-court pace factor. Distinguishes TEAM possessions (a game quantity) from ON-COURT possessions (a player quantity).
formula: poss_i = k_i * PACE_exp * MIN_i / 48. MIN_i is a random variable (use its distribution / draws). k_i = POS_ONCOURT_FACTOR (shrunk to 1). Verified building block: POSS ~= PACE_oncourt*MIN/48 (MAE 0.55).

formula: FGA_i = poss_i * r_i; log r_i = log r_i^{shrunk} + beta . [opp_FGA_allowed_factor, teammate_out_usage, starter_prob, rest, ...]. The betas are learned; no coefficient is assumed. Equivalent per-minute form: MIN_i * FGA_per_min * pace_ratio.

name: Expected three-pointers made (distribution)
description: Distribution of 3PM: attempts are overdispersed, makes are binomial given attempts - a compound distribution, not a single Poisson.
formula: N ~ NegBin(mean = EXP_3PA, dispersion alpha); 3PM | N ~ Binomial(N, p) with p = EXP_3P_PCT (optionally Beta-distributed for talent uncertainty). E[3PM] = E[N]*E[p] only if N and p are independent. Evaluate by simulation; compare tail probabilities for over/under lines.

name: Expected points (distribution)

Do NOT replace by product of expectations: E[PTS] differs when attempts and efficiency covary, and the variance is badly understated.

name: Expected rebounds (MVP baseline, rate-based)
description: MVP rebound projection that needs no tracking data: the player's rebound share while on court times the rebounds available during his projected minutes. Uses the verified REB% identity rearranged.
formula: REB% = REB * TeamMIN / (MIN * (TmREB + OppREB))  (reproduces API, r=0.982)  =>  E[REB] = REB%_hat * (E[MIN]/48) * TotalREB_exp, TotalREB_exp = a + b*misses_exp + c*FTA_exp with a,b,c re-fitted each season (2025-26 fit: 1.70, 0.873, 0.075; descriptive). The product of expectations ignores the covariance between minutes and the other terms - sample jointly. Distribution: NegBin(mean, alpha).
historical_availability: Verified for 2025-26 and 2026-27 (PlayerGameLogs/TeamGameLogs). Deeper history of these exact endpoints is UNTESTED; the underlying values are reproducible from box columns for any season where those exist.
pregame_availability: Yes - projection built pregame from lagged/pregame inputs
leakage_notes: Leak-free only if every input is itself as-of the target date. Fit and evaluate with walk-forward splits; never random k-fold across dates.
missing_data_handling: Fewer than N prior games -> shrink toward prior-season value, then position/archetype league mean (empirical-Bayes weight n/(n+k)); emit games_in_window as a companion feature.
validation_method: Compare with the opportunity-based EXP_REB_DIST (rebound chances x conversion) in ablation: is tracking worth its cost?
notes: Baseline for the REB pipeline. Assumes REB% is stable at the projected minutes and that the rebound supply relation holds out of sample.

name: Expected assists (MVP baseline, rate-based)
description: MVP assist projection that needs no tracking data: assist percentage times the teammate made field goals available during the player's projected minutes.
formula: AST% = AST / ((MIN/TeamMIN) * TmFGM - FGM)  (reproduces API, r=0.966)  =>  E[AST] = AST%_hat * ( (E[MIN]/48) * TmFGM_exp - FGM_exp_i ); TmFGM_exp = poss_game * team FGM per possession (rolling, opponent-adjusted); FGM_exp_i = EXP_FGA * shrunk FG%. Distribution: NegBin(mean, alpha). Ignores who is on the floor with the player.
dependencies: MIN_EXP; AST_PCT_ROLL; ENV_EXP_GAME_POSS; EXP_FGA; SHT_FG_PCT_SHRUNK; VAR_NB_DISPERSION
